title: Claimant Guidelines
description: Build rules and lore for Claimants (the enemy). Individual Claimants, once built, are sibling files in data/antagonists/claimants/ following creature.schema.json (id "type": "creature") — not stored inline here. Singleton file: data/antagonists/claimants/claimant-guidelines.json.

instanceIds.description: id refs of individual Claimants built so far, each a sibling file (e.g. claimant-three.json) following creature.schema.json. Empty until a Claimant is actually created — keep this list in sync by hand when adding/removing an instance file.
